company.shortDescription: PolyAI develops conversational artificial intelligence software that enables organizations to automate customer service interactions.
company.description: PolyAI develops conversational artificial intelligence software that enables organizations to automate customer service interactions through voice-based virtual agents. The company provides a platform that uses natural language understanding to handle inbound phone conversations, answer questions, complete tasks, and route calls based on customer intent. Its technology integrates with existing contact center systems and business tools to support order management, account inquiries, bookings, and issue resolution. PolyAI also offers tools for conversation design, testing, deployment, and performance monitoring to help teams manage and update voice interactions over time. The platform supports multiple languages and accents and is designed to operate continuously while collecting structured data from conversations for analysis and operational improvement.

aiResearchSummary.text: PolyAI is engaged in research and development of dialogue systems and methods for conversational artificial intelligence, as described in 'A dialogue system and a dialogue method' and 'Dialogue system and a dialogue method,' which detail systems for processing user speech or text and generating responses based on determined dialogue acts. Additionally, 'System and method for identification and verification' focuses on user verification in interactive voice response systems using speech data and fuzzy logic. These areas encompass dialogue management and user authentication.
